acceptance_timestamps.carries: filed date per fact (date granularity) from the facts store, plus intraday acceptance timestamps with accession numbers per recent 10-K and 10-Q filing from the EDGAR submissions fetch, carried per filer in acceptance_filings
acceptance_timestamps.missing: per fact accession linkage: the flattened facts store carries no accession id on any fact, so a single fact cannot be tied to one filing's acceptance timestamp; the filing level timestamps are on record

note: Cash conversion is computable point in time from filed dates for the filers and periods counted here. FE21's receivables and deferred revenue legs have no concept in the store. Acceptance timestamps landed 2026-10-30 at filing level from the submissions fetch; what keeps the route partial is the per fact accession linkage the flattened store cannot carry.
record: FE21 XBRL route, read from the terminal facts store

restatement_handling.rule: latest filed wins per concept and period; superseded values stay in the store and are counted here, never silently overwritten

store: morgue facts cache (EDGAR company facts, flattened)
